description:
Add a structured incident location to the existing complaint case 'HazMat-Spill-2024-001'. The incident occurred at '2500 East Second Street, Reno, NV 89595'. 

1. Login to ArkCase (admin/ArkCase1234!).
2. Locate the case 'HazMat-Spill-2024-001'.
3. Navigate to the Locations/Addresses section of the case.
4. Add a new Location/Address with the type 'Incident' (or 'Business').
5. Enter the specific address details provided above (Street, City, State, Zip).
6. Save the location.
